text:
We couldn’t recommend SAFE Fertility Clinic (Phuket) enough. My husband and I travelled from the UK to pursue IVF here, and the experience exceeded our expectations in every way.

Originally, we planned to do IVF at home in the UK, but we decided that going through the process in Phuket — a place we’ve always loved — might make the journey feel more positive and less stressful. After finding Dr. Manop Pinyopummintr and communicating with him over WhatsApp and Zoom before traveling, we immediately felt comfortable and confident moving forward.

From the very beginning, Dr. Manop and his entire team were outstanding. Communication was always clear and prompt, and they were incredibly patient and supportive with every question or concern we had. IVF can feel overwhelming, but the staff at SAFE made the whole process feel smooth, professional, and genuinely caring.

The clinic itself is modern, well organized, and the level of care we received was exceptional. What stood out most was how warm and attentive everyone was.

After only two months of treatment, I’m now heading back home pregnant, and we are beyond grateful. Choosing SAFE and Dr. Manop was one of the best decisions we could have made.

Thank you to the entire team for giving us such an incredible experience and helping make our dream come true!

text:
To make story short - stay away from this place.
And if you are seeking for details, I am willing to share my story...
Form the very first moment in this clinic, everything was wrong.
For just being able to talk to the doctor and ask few questions in order to make a decision if I wanna do this process, I was forced to signed many many forms, which I didn't have clue what is it about. I just wanted to ask few questions.
Eventually I started the procedure, even though I had alot of doubts.
Through all of the procedure, I felt like I am a human machine.
There was zero mental support from the crew.
After every visit, they just made sure the payment was done, and nothing more.
When I had questions to the doctor he was always patienless, looking at the watch while talking to me.
The suregey for taking the eggs - was the worse.
Just before the surgery I had to sign up a form, talking about  20% success rate... while the crew was all the time talking about 70% success rate. When I asked the doctor, he told me that this data are based on old researches, but I felt so uncomfortable to see such a huge gap and that I have to sign on it.
When I woke up after the surgery, it was incredible painful. I wanted to rest for a while in the bed, but the crew told me to go home very shortly after.
When meeting the doctor after the surgery, he didn't even ask how am I doing - this alone is a very unfroffisioal, and I am saying it as a doctor - it is a basic thing to ask a patience how is he doing after a fully anesthetic surgery.
It took me about a week to recover and I was so afraid that the pain is not normal. nobody prepared me for that.
I was alone in the process.
So - if a mental support is important to you, don't go to this place.
Believe me, I have trauma for life.
The treatment didn't succeed... maybe due to the mental stress I was gone through and maybe not. but this was not the point.
I had such a bad experieince that I decide never again to do this procedure again.
You also know, that the prices are unreasonably high... I heard about other places where it could be much cheaper...
Good luck for all you.
Dr. Mor Haas.
